sourceMethods: All 128 active subnet slots and 98 September 26–27 channel briefs screened.
191 public X account candidates sampled; 181 returned post links. Selected original posts read in full.
Signed-in AlphaGap feed, SubnetRadar, TAO Daily and TAO Media reviewed as discovery sources.
175 repository paths scanned; eleven selected commits checked at patch level.
Full-roster market outliers, emission leaders, 75 linked Moments and the preceding seven days of reports checked before selection.
YouTube Videos, Live and four watch pages rechecked: no new upload or schedule change found.
accessGaps: Research began with a 1:44 PM ET market snapshot and continued through 1:48 PM ET. This is a broad scan, not exhaustive coverage of X or private communities.
13 repository paths had access errors. Public X profile sampling is not a complete chronological search; no Grok scan is claimed.
Channel briefs and AlphaGap are secondary sources. Stories based on briefs retain developing labels; claims about live rewards and deployments were not independently checked on every validator.
SN82 has a reported deregistration and new registration. The new slot identity is unconfirmed; its historical return is not attributed to Compelle.
No fresh verified catalyst was found for SN36 Epago's weekly decline. No cause is inferred from price or generated wallet commentary.

decisions.reason: Updated market observation and next-day keynote reminder; the September 24 announcement is explicitly dated and not presented as a new launch.
Epago official X profile has no fresh post after September 16 and its repository has no commit in this window. The weekly decline alone does not establish a new project event or a cause.
Deregistration and replacement registration break project continuity. Cover the interruption and identity ambiguity rather than publish the apparent return as a Compelle rally.
Reviewed recent re-registration and NPU evaluation reporting; include attributed specification plans and time-labelled weekly return without claiming a launch.
Refreshed official Nepher feed still leads with Sept25 whitepaper; no newly verified catalyst for the 15 percent daily move. Price alone is insufficient for a new story.

editorialDecisions: SN82 registration event label may carry the previous identity; primary Compelle statement says deregistered. Do not merge identities or report a continuous investment return.
SN120 primary code supersedes earlier channel account: threshold changed to 0.10; operator crown remains distinct.
SN61 primary merged configuration establishes 0.9 ADA threshold and BEX replacement; deployment not asserted.
SN38 reminder explicitly labelled; SN108 recent re-registration and primary accounts reviewed.
AlphaGap emission-leader leads reviewed: SN81 covered; SN85, SN41, SN49 and SN28 had no sufficiently supported fresh material product event selected. No causal price/emission narrative inferred.
SN51 AlphaGap stability item has no fresh commit in the scan; do not recycle it. SN62 specialist competitions already announced before the window.
Exclude unsubstantiated self-mining accusations at SN49 and SN74. SN68 reward complaints lacked team confirmation.
Exclude recycled SN9 June training run, prior SN64 dataset coverage and unrelated StonkFun activity.
Moments coldkey schedules are not completed transfers; generated wallet motives excluded. Small SN46 lock retained in audit, not elevated to headline.
YouTube unchanged; preserve removed and postponed videos.
